services.name: Private Charter (Up to 14 Passengers)
services.desc: Enjoy a private charter exploring the low country! Rates Private Charter: $225 Per Hour Duration 1-8 Hour Options About Come aboard our custom 25ft boat rated for up to 14 passengers. This charter comes with a USCG captain to drive the boat so you and your group can sit back and enjoy the day hassle free. This is your charter to customize from dolphin watching, looking at high end real state, swimming, enjoy a sandbar, or grabbing luncher dinner on the water! Some popular dining spots include Hudsons, Boat House, Buffalo's at Palmetto Bluff, Old Daufuskie Crab Co. on Daufuskie Island to name a few. Book your custom experience with Island Head today! What to Bring Sunscreen Towels Sunglasses

services.name: Private Sunrise Cruise
services.desc: Come enjoy a cruise through the low country! Rates All Ages, Up to 14 Passengers Private Charter: $325 Duration 1.5 Hours About Come enjoy a cruise through the low country at the most peaceful time of day! Your captain will customize tour trip and show your group the beauty of the surrounding areas as we look for wildlife and enjoy a morning on the water!
